scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Trinity College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Analytics and Strategic Initiatives Center)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set 2025-2026 (G1, G5): tuition $72,820, required fees $3,330, on-campus food and housing $20,330 (housing $13,150 + meal plan $7,180). Estimated expenses for residents: books $1,000, transportation $500, other $1,100 (other costs shown = transportation + other). The CDS prints no total, so none is shown. Aid (H6, final 2024-25 data): the college's own need-based and non-need-based aid is available to degree-seeking nonresidents; the CDS prints 295 nonresident recipients, an average of $70,437 and a total of $20,779,007, but 295 is higher than the 252 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates in B2, so no count or average is shown as structured data. Nonresident first-year aid applicants must submit the CSS Profile (H7).

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class, from the Common Data Set (C1, C2, C9, C21). Residency rows (in-state 663 / out-of-state 3,262 / international 3,348 applicants; 241 / 1,740 / 167 admitted; 70 / 361 / 47 enrolled) add up to the totals (7,273 / 2,148 / 478) and the male + female counts match. International figures are as printed in the CDS residency table. The ED figures (643 applications, 261 admitted) cover Early Decision (ED I and ED II together). Test scores are optional: 9% of enrolled first-years (43) submitted the SAT and 4% (17) the ACT. Trinity left the high-school GPA tables (C11, C12) blank, so no GPA is shown; 57% of first-years were in the top tenth of their class and 82% in the top quarter (C10, 14% of students supplied class rank). ACT composite and section percentiles are printed with half points (for example 30.5 and 32.5). ACT Math/English percentiles are from the same table. The undergraduate enrollment (2,112) is B1 'Total all undergraduates'; the nonresident count (252) is the B2 degree-seeking undergraduates row (the B2 'Total Undergraduates' column was left blank).
